The '''1975–76 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 40th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 5 October 1975 and ended on 23 May 1976. [[PAOK FC|PAOK]] won their first Greek title in history.

The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point''.
